name: css-view
description: Capture computed CSS snapshots for any page via agent-browser, CDP, or Playwright

scripts.test: bun test --max-concurrency=1 src/e2e/__tests__ && bun test --max-concurrency=1 src/cli/__tests__ && bun test --max-concurrency=1 src/snapshot/__tests__
scripts.spelling: bun run spelling:test && uv run scripts/generate_typos_config.py && git ls-files -z '*.md' | xargs -0 -r uv tool run typos@1.48.0 --config typos.toml --force-exclude
scripts.spelling:test: PYTHONPATH=scripts uv run --python 3.13 --with pytest==9.0.2 --with pytest-cov==7.0.0 python -m pytest scripts/tests/test_typos_rollout.py --cov=generate_typos_config --cov=typos_rollout --cov=typos_rollout_cache --cov-fail-under=90

author: Payton McIntosh <pmcintosh@df12.net>
